name: caspulse
description: A compact portable TwitCasting companion with live comments, momentum, and optional in-app comment posting.
author: CASPULSE Project

scripts.dev:electron:run: wait-on tcp:5173 file:dist-electron/main/main.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron dist-electron/main/main.js
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:portable: npm run build && electron-builder --win portable --x64 && npm run clean:portable-artifacts
scripts.clean:portable-artifacts: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-ChildItem -Path release -Exclude CASPULSE.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"
